data.long_meaning: Derived from the French word 'franc', meaning 'free' or 'liberated'. In Christian tradition, it refers to those who are free in their faith, committed to their beliefs and values. The name Francoise carries the meaning “Free, Liberated” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Francoise usually hope their child will grow to embody free, liberated and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Francoise total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
